reading:
Night Timetable reached 7.76 with Departures, Posted (t2 #4 of 16; +0.58 on Joined, the first time it beat the yardstick). Interaction ranked it first for comprehension (8.0), type, usability and style put it at 7.8-8 for the most finished typography in the heat, and soul gave it 8.5.

WHAT THE JUDGES LOVE, and must survive:
- The departure board: time | destination on a phosphor dotted leader | day, the raster power-on, '1 more'.
- Vera's line down Home, from her screen through the lit box and the ways to start to a lit, breathing terminus.
- A sentence of state under every page head: '4 open · 2 late', '9 parts · 1 needs a look', '1 plan in September … next up tomorrow at 10:00'.
- The posted-list device: name, leader, fact.
- The one-family Archivo system: expanded 600 titles, normal for reading, condensed for figures.
- 'What's our plan?', which type called the finest-set title in the tour.
- One steel-denim link colour, the one-line To do timetable with a NOW rule and 'No date', the meridian chat, and the green afterglow edge at 120ms.

WHAT HELD IT BACK, most-cited first:
- (1) About 90% green by share of colour, 96% on Chat (feedback, soul, style, system, skeptic). Grounded colour has to arrive in SOLID things, above all the family's bubbles.
- (2) The box is a roughly 350px slot in a narrow centre column (interaction, type, usability, skeptic).
- (3) To do is drawn left of the box but reached after it, so the DOM order and the eye path disagree (system, usability).
- (4) At a squint the board outshines the box (soul, interaction).
- (5) Vera's line exists only on Home (feedback).
- (6) Settings' right-set states read as a price list ~700px from their names, and they truncate prose (system, interaction, type, usability).
- (7) Status lights 'This page' green while Settings says it needs a look: the tour's 'lamp that lies'. Its head also leaves out the needs-a-look count.
- (8) Small faults:
  - Ideas has tracked-caps column heads and puts Kind before the name.
  - '2 h 5 min' is unpadded.
  - The To do date stack is set at 12px.
  - The date beside 'Vera' is 12px.
  - Month chips truncate, and the busy week leaves 30px of dead slate.
  - The roundels drift toward Tube-map costume.

The tour's lessons sharpen this:
- A refinement must move Home's first screen or it 'reads as its parent'.
- Grafts take when they draw data the page already holds and REPLACE something.
- Leaders must not rule 700px rows.
- The light belongs on a short list at full strength.

WHAT WOULD MAKE IT WIN:
- A wide, first-read box on her line.
- The board answering it without beating it.
- The line carried onto Status, Settings, To do and the form.
- A chat that is no longer a green wall.
- The tube light at full strength on the board, the box, the terminus and the newest stop, and nowhere else.

briefs.name: Departures, Platformed
briefs.hypothesis:
Posted lost no idea; it lost on geometry and on colour share. Four things change what the thumbnail test sees on Home's first screen, and the judges asked for each by name:
- Her line moves to the left and becomes the widest column, so the box is the first thing read and the first thing reached.
- The board stands beside the box instead of out-glowing it.
- Chat stops being 96% green.
- The line itself reaches Settings, Status and the forms.

That answers all of the most-cited faults while keeping every device the judges said to keep. It is the lineage's own idea carried to every page, not a new one.
briefs.brief:
Start from t2-timetable-refine (palettes/t2-timetable-refine.json, variants/t2-timetable-refine/). Keep the tokens, Archivo's three widths, roundels, leaders, board, meridian and the To do timetable.

HOME (home.html; sheet.css 'Home: the concourse' ~1413-1600)
- Grid: replace the three-column concourse with two columns at 64rem and up: `.concourse { grid-template-columns: minmax(34rem, 1.35fr) minmax(0, 1fr); column-gap: 3rem }`.
- Left column `.line-col`, in this DOM order: her line (speaker, the _ask.html box, the ways to start, her last line, the 'Continue with Vera' terminus), then the setup `.service-notice`, then the Home To do.
- Right column, a new `<div class="side">`: Coming up (the board), then Lately added, then the kids' wishes.
- The DOM order now equals the visual column order: the box is the first Tab stop after the bar, and To do follows her line.
- At 1280 the box is about 620px wide. The title sits on one line at 2.75rem. The placeholder holds one line.
- Speaker line: her screen, 'Vera' at 1.3125rem, and the date at 0.875rem regular (not 12px bold condensed).
- Squint balance:
  - Box: give `.welcome` the original greeting light, E7. That is a `::before` pool rising from under Send through 3px scanlines inside the box plate, at the kit's (37,80,52) under Send, plus E4's lit frame.
  - Send: exact #6dff9c with E3's ring and pool.
  - Board: drop the case's outer spill one step (the `.crt.next-up` box-shadow spread from 28px to 18px). The tube's bloom, blur and scanlines stay at screenGlow 1.0.
- Ways to start become INTERCHANGES (Night Interchange, tour/t2-a/variants/t2-timetable-graft: sheet.css ~1392-1440 and ~1558-1600, _ask.html).
  - Each key hangs off her line at a steel ring with a 3px enamel stub.
  - At the key's right end, a 0.875rem (14px) normal-width label in --label reads 'usually Plans' / 'usually To do' / 'usually Ideas'. It is a hint, as the skeptic asked.
  - The destination is mapped by the starter's text in the template (weekend→plans, Remind→todo, We should try→ideas), never by loop index.
  - The stub enamel is grounded: `color-mix(in oklch, var(--plans) 55%, var(--steel))` and the like, near C 0.06.
  - Keys stay at least 44px tall.
- Board (sheet.css 'The boards' ~1790-2075):
  - Rows at 0.9375rem, each with its day ('13:00 Oaks Park roller rink …… Sun 4 Oct').
  - Next up keeps its date whole on one line ('10:00 Thu 1 Oct, tomorrow').
  - Add Interchange's refresh line (t2-timetable-graft sheet.css ~2020-2040; the markup is a `.roll` span inside the tube). It runs once, 1.25s, delay .15s, with warm-up ≤0.1s. It never runs over the box, and it is off under reduced motion.
- Home To do:
  - Late rows get a small amber ring lamp in the row's margin and 'was due 3 days ago' in --late.
  - A thin NOW rule with a lit lamp (E20) sits between the late rows and the rest, as on the To do page.
  - Owners are in ink-2 with the person icon.
- Section heads on Home: the roundel shrinks to 1.25rem, steel ring, with the enamel only on the 3rem lead under the head. That is one enamel mark per head, as the skeptic and system asked.
- Footer: unchanged.

CHAT (chat.html, _ui.html chat_line; sheet.css 'The conversation: a meridian' 1099-1300)
- Keep the meridian, with Vera on the left and the family on the right, and the date said once.
- Family bubbles `.said-them .bubble` become a grounded SOLID.
  - The new token `--plate-family: #1c2631` is a steel-denim plate, C about 0.025.
  - Its edge is `color-mix(in srgb, var(--link) 30%, var(--card-edge))`, and the existing inset 2px --link edge is kept.
  - The family's initial disc becomes a bone disc (#d6ccb6 text on #2a2a26, ring --bone 40%).
- Vera's older bubbles go to matte slate (`--bubble: #141a1c`) with pewter edges.
- Only `.stop#latest` is lit: her screen tile at full E19, the green edge, and its time set in --brand with E1's halo.
- Times in the margin are 0.875rem regular, tabular.
- Target: Chat's green share under 60%.

TO DO (tasks.html; sheet.css 2355-2617)
- The margin stamp becomes one line, 'Sun 27 Sep 19:56', at 0.875rem regular tabular. Set `--stamp: 8.75rem`. Late stamps are in --late.
- The rest stays: keys, the NOW rule, one row per task with 'Edit'.
- Drop the '#4' ids, or set them after the title at 0.75rem in --faint.

PLANS (plans.html, plans_month.html; sheet.css 2180-2355)
- Weeks wholly gone by fold to a 2.75rem 'departed' strip. Take this from Interchange (t2-timetable-graft sheet.css ~2305 and its plans_month.html).
- Week rows size to their content: drop the fixed 6rem and use `min-height: 4.5rem`.
- Chips wrap to two lines with `white-space: normal` and no ellipsis.
- Today is ringed in steel with a lit lamp. The weekday heads are sentence case ('Mon'), 0.8125rem, untracked.
- The month's foot reads 'October continues · Later →', as the 44px link.

STATUS (status.html; sheet.css 2617-2729)
- Head: '5 working · 1 needs a look · about $0.00 of $2.00 today', with '1 needs a look' in --late.
- Each `.light-row`: the lamp, then the name, then a plain 0.875rem state word ('Working', 'Not set up', 'Needs a look'), unboxed, then the detail.
- 'This page' (the installer's password) takes `.light.look`: an amber half lamp (`background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--late) 50%, transparent 50%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--late)`). Its state comes from the same check Settings uses, so no lamp lies.
- One legend line under the head: lit, ring and half, each with its word.
- The Who answers and Connected to lists hang on ONE steel line down their left edge, each lamp a stop. That is her line carried here.

SETTINGS (settings.html; sheet.css 2729-2873)
- `.section-card` becomes a grid: `grid-template-columns: 2.25rem 13rem 1fr 1.25rem`.
- Each row reads: the stop ring (the section icon in a steel ring on a steel line running down the list), the name, then the state LEFT-aligned in the second column, wrapping onto a second line and never truncated (remove the ellipsis and the title=), then the arrow.
- No leader.
- The 'Needs a look' row gets an amber ring stop and the amber word.
- The line ends in a terminus ring at 'Setup' below the list.

IDEAS (ideas.html; sheet.css 2113-2180)
- Column heads are sentence case at 0.8125rem condensed 600, untracked, in this order: 'Idea', 'Kind', 'For', 'By road', 'Way'. The name comes first; kind is its icon plus word after it; '#' goes last at 0.75rem.
- Durations read '2 h 05 min', with figures at 600 and units at 400 in --dim.
- 'anyone' is lower case everywhere.
- The radar board's height is capped at its content (max 20rem).

FORM (idea_form and every plate form)
- The plate is a line to its terminus: one steel rail down the plate's left inside edge, a ring stop level with each label, ending in a lit terminus ring beside 'Add it' (the primary, E3). One rail per page, never a second on General's groups.

PHONE
- Order: her line (box first), the notice, To do, the board, Lately added, the wishes.
- The tab bar keeps icons and words, with no numerals anywhere.

LIGHT LIST (full strength, kit E1-E21)
- The mark and cursor, 'plan' (E1), the box (E4, E7), Send (E3), focus (E5), the top haze (E6), the board (E12-E16, refresh), the radar (E17), her screen (E19), the terminus and the status lamps breathing (E20), the newest chat stop, and the row afterglow as a green edge (E9).
- Everything else is matte slate, warm ink and steel.
- RM, MC and FC as in the kit. No inline styles or scripts.
briefs.borrows:
The judges' fixes, most-cited first:
- Grounded colour in solids, Chat under 60% green: feedback, soul, style, system and skeptic. Denim family plate, bone initial, matte older Vera bubbles, only the newest lit.
- Widen the box column and put her line first in the DOM and the eye: interaction, type, usability, skeptic, system.
- Box pool up and board spill down so 'plan' wins the squint: soul, interaction.
- Carry Vera's line past Home onto Status, Settings and the form: feedback, with one rail per page from Interchange's usability note.
- Settings states left-aligned beside the names and never truncated: system, interaction, type, usability.
- Status: needs-a-look in the head, 'This page' as an amber half lamp, unboxed state words, a legend once: interaction, plus the tour's 'lamp that lies' lesson.
- Interchange hints at 14px as 'usually …': style and interaction, with the skeptic's hint wording and tour lesson failed reach 2.
- Board refresh line: soul and style. Board rows at 15px with dates: Night Departures' system and usability notes.
- Ideas: sentence-case heads with the name first, '2 h 05 min', one case for 'anyone': type, usability.
- To do date on one 14px line: type, usability.
- Month chips wrap, rows sized to content, past weeks folded: usability, soul, skeptic, and the lessons' principle 3.
- Home To do with late lamps and NOW: skeptic.
- Roundels smaller, enamel only on the lead: skeptic, system.
- Date beside Vera at 14px regular: type.

Small borrowings from the lineage's own sibling Night Interchange (tour/t2-a/variants/t2-timetable-graft): the interchange keys (sheet.css ~1392-1440 and ~1558-1600, _ask.html), the refresh line (~2020-2040) and the departed-week strip with 'October continues' (~2305, plans_month.html).
briefs.avoids:
- 'About 90% green, Chat 96%': solid denim family plates, matte older bubbles, enamel stubs.
- 'The box is a 350px slot' and 'To do comes before the question': a 1.35fr left column with the line first in the DOM.
- 'The board outshines the box': the pool goes up and the spill comes down.
- 'Vera's line is drawn mostly on Home': the line on Status, Settings and the form.
- 'Settings reads like a price list' and its truncated prose.
- Status's lamp lying about 'This page', and the head that omits needs-a-look.
- Tracked-caps Ideas heads and Kind before the name.
- '2 h 5 min'.
- The 12px To do stack and 12px date.
- Truncated month chips and 30px of dead slate.
- 'Close to a Tube-map costume': the roundels are smaller and carry one enamel mark.
- Interchange's own faults: 13px tags become 14px hints, there is one rail per page, and lamps carry words instead of boxed chips.
briefs.title: What's our *plan*? It is kept: the lineage's best title (best or joint best in six of eight heat-a notes, and type's 'finest-set title in the tour'). It is now set in Archivo expanded 600 at 2.75rem in a column wide enough to keep it on one line at every width, with only 'plan' carrying E1's two-layer halo at the line's end. It is the family's own kitchen-table question in the household's 'our', and its lit word is the planner's whole job: the weekend, ideas, reminders, the calendar and wishes are all 'the plan'.

briefs.name: Departures, Printed
briefs.hypothesis:
The parent's leaders and wide right-set rows are what made Settings, Status and Ideas read as a wireframe or a price list, and its board stood as a rival to the box rather than as part of her line. A printed night timetable answers both faults with three things that are not glow:
- Banded rows on slate (green-bar paper) replace the leaders.
- Times sit in sunk readout windows in the margin.
- A tiny almanac of moon phases marks the month.

The board is hung ON her line, beneath the box, by a lit wire from its power lamp, so box and board read as one lit line with the box first. The tour's lesson says a graft takes when it replaces something with the page's own data. Each borrowing here replaces a leader, a stamp or a free-floating board.
briefs.brief:
Start from t2-timetable-refine (palettes/t2-timetable-refine.json, variants/t2-timetable-refine/). Keep Archivo's three widths, the meridian, the board's content and leaders, the head sentences and steel-denim links.

HOME (home.html; sheet.css ~1413-1600)
- Grid: two columns at 64rem and up, `minmax(34rem, 1.3fr) minmax(0, 1fr)`.
- LEFT is her line alone, top to bottom, in DOM order:
  - Her screen plus the date at 0.875rem regular. Her name is now in the title, so the separate 'Vera' word goes; the screen keeps an aria-label.
  - The box (the stop you are at: E4 frame, E7 pool, Send at E3).
  - The ways to start, as one row of 44px keys hanging from a single ring stop.
  - The departure board as the NEXT STOP, hung from the line (graft 1).
  - The terminus 'Continue with Vera'.
- RIGHT, in DOM order after the left: the setup notice (one line), To do, Lately added, the kids' wishes.
- The box is first in reading, Tab order and the squint. The board sits under it, about 2/3 of the box's width plus the radar.
- Board rows at 0.9375rem with their dates.
- Home To do: rows banded (graft 3), each with a small readout window at its right margin (graft 2) holding 'Sun 27 Sep' and the time, with an amber ring when late and 'was due 3 days ago' beside it in --late. A NOW rule with a lit lamp separates late from coming.

CHAT (chat.html; sheet.css 1099-1300)

- The rail, NOW rule and keys stay.

STATUS (status.html)

FORM

briefs.borrows:
FEATURES (each rebuilt in the timetable's slate, steel, warm ink and Archivo):

1. THE LIT WIRE: the board hung on her line. From Lit Sill Line (t2-track-graft, the track series' current design): tour/t3-a/variants/t2-track-graft/templates/home.html L74-78 (`.sill-run`, `.wire`, `.stop-one`) and sheet.css `.wire{…}` and `.sill-run`.
- Rebuilt vertical. From the Next up board's power lamp (`.crt` lower-left) a 2px wire runs left into Vera's steel rail. It is #6dff9c with a 1px --hot core (`linear-gradient(var(--hot),var(--hot)) 50% 0/1px 100% no-repeat, #6dff9c`), under the kit's two-layer halo.
- A lit ring stop sits where the wire meets the rail.
- The rail from the box's stop down to that stop is lit as the live stretch, now to next. The rest of the rail is steel.
- It answers soul's t1 fix 'put the board on her line as the stop after the box, so the lit board and the lit box read as one line', and interaction's 'make the question beat the board'.

2. L034 Date and time in a sunk readout window, a GEM from Bench Scope (r10-wild-2, #15 of 19). Files: rounds/r10/variants/r10-wild-2/templates/_ui.html macro chip (L119-128); sheet.css `.chip`, `.chip-day`, `.chip.is-today` (L648-661) and `.task .due .chip` (L1354-1356).
- Rebuilt as the timetable's time windows: a well of #070a0a with `box-shadow: inset 0 1px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / .85)` and 4px radius.
- Inside, Archivo condensed 600 tabular at 0.875rem in ink: 'Sun 27 Sep · 19:56'. It is sentence case, never caps or mono, with no slashed zero.
- The ring is steel for today and amber only for late.
- It replaces the To do `.stamp`, Chat's `.said-at`, the Plans chip time, Ideas' By road figure, Status's 30-day figure and Home To do's due words.
- It is never a button: no hover and no pointer.
- It is the lineage's 'times in the margin' made material.

3. L010 Green-bar banding, rows and weeks, a GEM from Orchard Greenbar (r7-rand-6, #8 of 12). Files: rounds/r7/palettes/r7-rand-6.json css: `--band`, `.plain > li:nth-child(odd)`, `.data tbody tr:nth-child(odd) td`, `table.month tbody tr:nth-child(even) td`.
- Rebuilt on slate, per the ledger's caveat: tray #10161a and band #151c21, a visible step of about 3 dE.
- It replaces the dotted leaders and hairlines on the wide rows: the Settings directory, the Status lists, the Ideas table, the To do page and Home To do, the Plans weeks to come and the forms' field groups.
- Leaders survive only on the board (phosphor dots), the wishes and Lately added, which are narrow.
- Rows stay at least 44px.
- A printed timetable is banded. This answers 'leaders rule the reading' and Settings' 'price list'.

4. L086 Moon phases on the month, worked out from the date, a GEM from Zenith Desk (r12-wild-3, #14 of 17). Files: rounds/r12/variants/r12-wild-3/templates/plans_month.html (~15 and ~43-50: the mean-lunation computation and `<span class="moon moon-{{ moon }}" aria-hidden="true">`); sheet.css `.moon`, `.moon-full`, `.moon-first`, `.moon-last`, `.moon-new` (~1997-2010).
- Rebuilt as a 0.625rem ring in --faint at each phase-day cell's top right, filled or half-filled in --ink-2, aria-hidden, and hidden under FC.
- It is a night-timetable almanac detail drawn from the date alone, with no model call. It is not lit, and there are no weekend columns.

FREE FIXES taken as well:
- The box column widened and put first in the DOM (interaction, usability, system, skeptic).
- The family bubbles in a solid (soul, feedback, style, system).
- Status's amber half lamp and its head count (interaction).
- Sentence-case Ideas heads with the name first (type, usability).
- Month chips wrapping, past weeks folded (usability, soul).
- The board refresh line (soul, style).
- 44px targets and sentence-case controls throughout.
briefs.avoids:
- The board out-glowing the box: the board now hangs below the box on her line, so the box comes first and is larger.
- 'Vera's line only on Home': the line now joins the board, and the bands and windows carry the posted timetable onto every page.
- About 90% green (Chat 96%): bands, windows, solid family plates and matte older bubbles.
- The narrow box and To do drawn before the question.
- Leaders across 700px rows, and Settings' price list.
- Status's lying 'This page' lamp.
- Tracked-caps Ideas heads and the 12px To do stack, both now one-line windows.
- Truncated chips and dead month slate.

It also avoids the tour's pasted-graft traps:
- Every window holds a fact the row already owns and replaces its old setting rather than restating it.
- No new code to learn (no ladders, no unnamed lamps).
- No numerals in the bar.
- The moons are tiny and silent.
- No main-line structure is imported.
briefs.title: Tell Vera our *plans*. This is NEW and untried. It keeps the household 'our' that made 'What's our plan?' the lineage's best, and borrows 'Tell Vera', which made 'Tell Vera what to plan.' the clearest label in heat b. It names whose line this is, which matters on a page where the line is hers. The plural 'plans' answers the skeptic's doubt that 'our plan' presumes one exists: it covers the weekend, an idea to keep, a reminder and the calendar alike. The lit word closes the line before the full stop, where the eye stops. At 21 characters it holds one line at 2.5rem in the 1.3fr column and on a phone at 2rem. Her name now lives in the title, so the separate 'Vera' word beside her screen goes.
